source.author: stat
source.text: et iam corporibus sese spoliisque cadentum clauserat; unum acies circum consumitur, unum omnia tela vovent: summis haec ossibus haerent, pars frustrata cadunt, partem Tritonia vellit, multa rigent clipeo, densis iam consitus hastis ferratum quatit umbo nemus, tergoque fatiscit atque umeris gentilis aper; nusquam ardua coni gloria, quique apicem torvae Gradivus habebat cassidis, haud laetum domino ruit omen: inusta temporibus nuda aera sedent, circumque sonori vertice percusso volvuntur in arma molares.
source.text_original: et iam corporibus sese spoliisque cadentum / clauserat; unum acies circum consumitur, unum / omnia tela vovent: summis haec ossibus haerent, / pars frustrata cadunt, partem Tritonia vellit, / multa rigent clipeo, densis iam consitus hastis / ferratum quatit umbo nemus, tergoque fatiscit / atque umeris gentilis aper; nusquam ardua coni / gloria, quique apicem torvae Gradivus habebat / cassidis, haud laetum domino ruit omen: inusta / temporibus nuda aera sedent, circumque sonori / vertice percusso volvuntur in arma molares.
source.text_english: and now he had shut himself in with the bodies and spoils of the fallen; the whole battle line is consumed around one man, all the weapons are vowed at one man: some stick in the topmost bones, some, frustrated, fall away; Tritonia tears away part of them, many are stiffened on the shield, and the boss, now thickly planted with spears, shakes the iron grove; and the native boar is shattered on the back and shoulders; nowhere is there the proud glory of the crest, and the plume that Gradivus wore on the grim helmet brings no happy omen to its master: bare bronze, scorched into the temples, lies there, and around, with the ringing top struck, the teeth roll back among the weapons of the whetstone.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ille pavens, laeto quamquam omine divum, prosiluit stratis.
reuse.text_original: ille pavens, laeto quamquam omine divum, / prosiluit stratis.
reuse.text_english: Trembling, he sprang up from his couch, though the gods had given a favorable omen.
